sourceScope: Current development; match the documented source revision.
data: Use fictional records in a disposable local installation.

shots.alt: The installer lists its checks. The countries and states check failed and offers an install button.
shots.caption: A failed check shows its cause and, where possible, an action to fix it.
shots.requiredState: Fresh migrated database without country reference data.

shots.alt: The completed installer form for a fictional school district and its first elementary campus.
shots.caption: All checks pass and the form holds the administrator, organization, and first campus.
shots.requiredState: All checks pass; form filled with fictional administrator and campus details; demo notice off.

shots.alt: Quick setup opens on the school details step after the first sign-in.
shots.caption: Quick setup guides you from school details to the first academic year.
shots.requiredState: First sign-in after installation.

shots.alt: The dashboard for Riverside High School shows the working year and semester, setup progress, attendance today, the next seven days, and trends.
shots.caption: The working bar names the school year and term that every screen uses.
shots.requiredState: Working campus and academic context selectors are visible.

shots.alt: The school setup checklist groups its steps and marks each one done or open.
shots.caption: Each open step says why it is open and links to the screen that finishes it.
shots.requiredState: Campus setup details and terminology are visible.

shots.alt: Feature switches list the tools the school uses, grouped by area, with 11 of 12 turned on.
shots.caption: A feature switch controls the whole application area.
shots.requiredState: Feature switches show Attendance enabled and Library disabled.

shots.alt: The role form has a name field and permission check boxes grouped by area.
shots.caption: Select only the permissions required for the job.
shots.requiredState: A custom role form shows a selected set of permissions.

shots.alt: The organization list shows Riverside Unified School District with two campuses.
shots.caption: Organization ownership and campus access are separate.
shots.requiredState: The organization list contains two fictional campuses in one organization.

shots.alt: The invitation list shows one pending invitation with its expiry and its resend and revoke actions.
shots.caption: A new invitation replaces earlier unused links.
shots.requiredState: The invitation list shows an unused invitation and its expiry.

shots.section: Suspend, archive, or reinstate an account
shots.alt: The Sign-in section of a teacher's profile, with the account menu open on Send invitation, Suspend account, and Archive account.
shots.caption: The account menu sits beside the account status in **Sign-in**.
shots.requiredState: An active teacher at this campus, with the account menu open.

shots.section: Set a password for another person
shots.alt: The Set password form shows New password, Confirm password, and the Change it at next sign-in checkbox.
shots.caption: The form opens in place, under **Sign-in**.
shots.requiredState: An active teacher at this campus, with the Set password form open.

shots.alt: The student list shows fictional learners with email, admission number, class, section, and enrollment state.
shots.caption: The student list. Open **Create student** from here.
shots.requiredState: The student list shows fictional learners with admission and placement details.

shots.alt: The Create student form shows the person's details, then an Admission group with Section, Admission number and Date of admission, and the Admit learner button.
shots.caption: The admission form. Section is the only admission field you must choose. The admission number is made for you when left blank.
shots.requiredState: The full form, with an active section available.

shots.alt: A learner's profile shows the Enrollment section with its status, admission number, admission date, class and section, then status and placement history.
shots.caption: The **Enrollment** section of the profile. The ellipsis on its right opens **Change the enrollment**.
shots.requiredState: An active learner with one placement.

shots.alt: The Change placement form under Enrollment shows the destination section, the effective date, the optional reason, and Save placement.
shots.caption: The placement form opens inside the **Enrollment** section.
shots.requiredState: Change the enrollment → Change placement is open for an active learner.

shots.alt: The Change enrollment status form shows the status list, the effective date, the optional reason, and Save status.
shots.caption: The status form opens inside the **Enrollment** section.
shots.requiredState: Change the enrollment → Change status is open for an active learner.

shots.alt: The waitlist for a full section shows one candidate with an open offer and one candidate still waiting.
shots.caption: An open offer reserves a section seat.
shots.requiredState: The queue shows a waiting candidate and an offered seat.

shots.alt: The parent list shows fictional guardians with their email and account state.
shots.caption: The parent list. Open a parent to see the learners linked to them.
shots.requiredState: The guardian directory leads to a fictional guardian with linked learners.

shots.alt: The Create parent form shows the person's name, email, contact and address fields, and the Add parent button.
shots.caption: The parent form. A new guardian gets an email link to set a password.
shots.requiredState: The empty form.

shots.alt: A parent's profile shows contact details, Sign-in, and a Linked learners section with the Change linked learners button.
shots.caption: The **Linked learners** section of the parent's profile lists learners at this campus.
shots.requiredState: A guardian linked to one learner here.

shots.alt: The assignment page shows Section and Learner lists, the Link learner button, and the linked learners with an Unlink button each.
shots.caption: The assignment page. Each linked learner has its own **Unlink** button.
shots.requiredState: A guardian linked to one learner here.

shots.alt: A request from Maple Grove Middle School to move a learner into Grade 9 waits for this campus to approve or reject it.
shots.caption: Review the destination and approval state before completing a move.
shots.requiredState: A pending move lists the source, destination, and decision state.

shots.alt: Record sharing lists the requests asked of this school and by this school, each with its state.
shots.caption: Approval and receipt are separate record-sharing steps.
shots.requiredState: A sharing request displays selected categories and its current state.

shots.alt: The academic year list shows the 2026–27 year with its dates, two semesters, and Open status.
shots.caption: Check period dates and status before operational work.
shots.requiredState: A fictional academic cycle lists dated periods and their statuses.

shots.alt: Sections are grouped by grade and show their room, capacity, homeroom teacher, and status.
shots.caption: Section capacity includes suspended enrollments and open offers.
shots.requiredState: Sections show their levels, cycle, and capacity.

shots.alt: Subjects being taught list each subject with its grade, year, term, section, teacher, and status.
shots.caption: An offering defines the teaching context and learner roster.
shots.requiredState: Offerings show the subject, level, period, and active state.

shots.alt: A Grade 10 register shows fictional learners with present, absent, late, and excused states.
shots.caption: Use explicit attendance states and review unrecorded entries.
shots.requiredState: A daily register shows fictional learners and mixed attendance states.

shots.alt: The 10A timetable has a published revision and a draft revision that is not published.
shots.caption: Publish only after reviewing timetable conflicts.
shots.requiredState: The timetable list distinguishes draft and published revisions.

shots.alt: Syllabus coverage lists each subject and grade with topics covered and topics behind plan.
shots.caption: A published outline and recorded coverage are separate.
shots.requiredState: Topic coverage distinguishes covered, partial, and outstanding work.

shots.alt: The exam list for Fall semester shows the midterm and final exam windows.
shots.caption: Exam dates describe the assessment window.
shots.requiredState: The exam list shows an assessment window inside a teaching period.

shots.alt: The marksheet for one assessment shows marks for each learner and an Absent entry state.
shots.caption: Review marks and entry states before submitting results.
shots.requiredState: The selected gradebook marksheet shows numeric marks and explicit entry states.

shots.alt: Approved results list each learner's percentage, revision, and approval date.
shots.caption: Families read approved publication revisions.
shots.requiredState: The selected academic record shows approved publication data and its revision.

shots.alt: Two graduation plans show their credits, requirement count, and who they apply to.
shots.caption: Graduation progress uses approved subject results.
shots.requiredState: A plan shows requirements, credits, and learner progress.

shots.alt: The October calendar shows school events and a staff development day when the school is shut.
shots.caption: A closure day differs from closing an academic period.
shots.requiredState: A calendar shows a fictional event and a closure day.

shots.alt: The notice list shows each notice with its start and stop dates.
shots.caption: The scheduler controls due publication and expiry.
shots.requiredState: The notice list shows scheduled and published messages.

shots.alt: The case list shows two fictional behaviour cases with their kind, state, date, and handler.
shots.caption: Case category affects access to its records.
shots.requiredState: The case list uses fictional facts and shows category and status.

shots.alt: The support plan list shows two fictional plans with their learner, kind, state, and review date.
shots.caption: Confidential support requires its specific access permission.
shots.requiredState: A fictional support plan shows its category, review date, and progress.

shots.alt: The staff leave board shows who is away today and a form to ask for days away.
shots.caption: Approved leave affects teaching availability.
shots.requiredState: The leave board shows fictional requests and their decision state.

shots.alt: The programme list shows a special programme and a club, each with the number of learners taking part.
shots.caption: Programme participation does not change class placement.
shots.requiredState: A programme record shows fictional learners and participation states.

shots.alt: The facilities page lists the next bookings and the rooms and equipment the campus shares.
shots.caption: Facility bookings share availability checks with published timetables.
shots.requiredState: The facility page shows availability and a dated booking.

shots.alt: A morning roll for Cedar House shows five boarders, three answered and two not recorded.
shots.caption: Complete the roll after recording every required entry.
shots.requiredState: The roll sheet shows fictional boarders and recorded states.

shots.alt: The lending desk shows books out now with barcodes and due dates, two of them late.
shots.caption: A loan belongs to a physical copy and an eligible borrower.
shots.requiredState: The lending desk shows copy identifiers, due dates, and active loans.

shots.alt: A checked import shows five rows read, three ready, two with errors, and the message for each error.
shots.caption: Checking a file does not apply its rows.
shots.requiredState: An import batch shows valid rows, invalid rows, and row error messages.

shots.alt: The report desk shows one Ready class list and its download action.
shots.caption: Download a report after the build reaches Ready.
shots.requiredState: The report desk shows one Ready export and its download action.

shots.alt: The finance page shows amounts owed and received and the invoice list for the 2026–27 school year.
shots.caption: Review issued fee lines before taking money.
shots.requiredState: An invoice lists fee lines, amount due, and payment actions.

shots.alt: The payment form shows what the learner owes, the amount, date, method, reference, and note fields.
shots.caption: Record money received and review any credit left unallocated.
shots.requiredState: The invoice payment form shows method, amount, reference, and allocation.

shots.alt: Below the invoices, one financial period is open and the previous one is closed.
shots.caption: Financial periods control ledger posting independently of teaching.
shots.requiredState: Financial-period controls distinguish open and closed periods.

shots.alt: The family overview shows one linked learner at Riverside High School and the areas the family can open.
shots.caption: Choose the learner before opening family records.
shots.requiredState: The family overview shows only fictional linked learners and available areas.

shots.alt: A parent's request form sits above earlier requests, one of them answered by the school.
shots.caption: A request response does not directly change the underlying record.
shots.requiredState: The family request and staff inbox show the submitted state and response.
